claims.claim_text: Discovery tooling: an enumeration burst, plus single hits observed from 2026-09-21T02:05:58.7173986Z to 2026-09-21T02:05:59.9266970Z.

assertions.text: The recorded activity is: Discovery tooling: an enumeration burst, plus single hits
assertions.note: No enumeration burst: fewer than three distinct discovery binaries.

claims.notes: Discovery tooling and single hits are supported: whoami.exe and ipconfig.exe ran once each from PowerShell, each logged as Security 4688 and Sysmon 1. The enumeration burst is not: only two distinct discovery binaries ran. R-EXEC-01 defines an enumeration burst as at least three distinct discovery binaries by one account within 120 s, and the engine labelled each of these detections a single hit outside any enumeration burst. The cited PowerShell start at 02:05:47 is context outside the span. The stated start and end are the timestamps of the first and last in-span cited records.
